title: Nafasi niliyopenda zaidi kwenye kazi yangu ya muda McDonald's ilikuwa runner
label: Runner

text.At McDonald's, there are many positions,: McDonald's kuna nafasi nyingi, kama kuandaa chipsi na vinywaji, kuhudumia kaunta na kukusanya oda.
text.Among them, my favorite was \"runner.\": Kati ya hizo, nilipenda zaidi nafasi ya “runner.”
text.The runner is the person who puts drinks: Runner huweka vinywaji, chipsi na baga pamoja kwenye mfuko au trei kisha kumpa mteja.
text.I think it is probably the position at M: Nadhani hii ndiyo nafasi McDonald's inayohitaji kufanya mambo mengi kwa wakati mmoja zaidi.
text.There is a target for serving time, so i: Kuna lengo la muda wa kutoa oda, kwa hiyo kazi huwa nyingi sana.
text.But if needed, you can go help with drin: Lakini ikihitajika unaweza kusaidia vinywaji, chipsi na kukusanya oda, hivyo wenzako wanakutegemea.
text.You also say \"Welcome\" the most, and y: Pia wewe ndiye unayesema “Karibu” mara nyingi zaidi, na unazungumza sana na watu wa jikoni.
text.I also liked that nobody says anything e: Nilipenda pia kwamba hakuna anayesema chochote hata nikizunguka kila sehemu ya mgahawa; hali ilikuwa huru.
Wakati wa chakula cha mchana ulikuwa wa kufurahisha hasa.
text.While burgers kept piling up, handling t: Baga zilipokuwa zikijikusanya, nilifurahia kuzipanga haraka huku nikisema, “hii ni ya mteja huyu.”
text.By the way, mistakes like \"○○ is missin: Jambo lingine, makosa kama “kitu fulani hakipo” au “baga siyo sahihi” mara nyingi hulaumiwa runner.
text.At McDonald's in Nagoya, Uber Eats order: Oda za Uber Eats katika McDonald's ya Nagoya zilikuwa za ajabu
